experiments.name: Regime flip cooldown zero
experiments.config_data_change: Set hmm.flip_cooldown_bars to 0 to isolate cooldown-driven no-trade behavior.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Regime no-trade rate should fall if current no-trade behavior is mostly cooldown-policy driven.
experiments.risk: May admit unstable recently flipped regime rows and increase losing candidates.

experiments.name: KNN small-K softmax
experiments.config_data_change: Use smaller K values with softmax weighting around the least-bad existing sweep zone.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Accepted trade count should increase toward 25+ and expectancy should beat the previous k=16 softmax diagnostic baseline.
experiments.risk: Can increase candidate count without proving positive costed expectancy.

experiments.name: KNN observed-core feature subset
experiments.config_data_change: Remove currently constant or neutralized perp and microstructure fields from KNN distance.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Neighbor quality median should improve from the current baseline and candidate density should increase.
experiments.risk: Improved geometry can still remove useful market-condition filters and remain non-profitable.

experiments.name: KNN price-trend-WT3D subset
experiments.config_data_change: Restrict KNN distance to path shape, trend/chop, volatility, and WT3D state.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Distance quality should improve versus baseline; accepted trades should land in the 25 to 60 diagnostic range if smaller K restores density.
experiments.risk: May discard sparse perp/context information that still matters as a filter.
